reviews.review_text:
Charley L
Cirencester, United Kingdom243 contributions
0
Design over substance
Feb 2020
I'd identified a couple of Skybars in the city but we ended up in this one. After being escorted off the street to the lifts by a freezing young woman, we were met at the top of the stairs by a Maitre D' who told me I couldn't come in in flipflops. (As this bar wasn't on our original list, I hadn't investigated dress codes!). He offered me a pair of ballet slippers which were obviously never going to fit a Western size 7, then a pair of men's Zara slip-ons ... both left feet! I eventually got the right foot and he showed us out to the open air part. I asked a waitress if we could sit at a table by the edge and she deferred to the Maitre D who didn't seem interested! The biggest disappointment was the beer - no local beers available at all. We ordered two bottles of Bud at 30,000 VND (around £10) - far and away the most pricey beers of the whole two weeks trip. The views are staggering and the moon came up, but other members of our group found better Skybars with cheaper, local beer.

reviews.review_text:
Hannahboz
18 contributions
0
Very happy accident
Oct 2017 • Couples
We looked at a blog with the 10 best rooftop bars and then used trip advisor to see which one looked good and choose one.

We made our way to that bar but got confused and got out of the lift at the wrong stop and ended up here. 

What a happy mistake that was! It was 5 pm so I don't think it had actually even opened yet but rather than making us feel awkward they told us to order at 5.30 for happy hour they said we can walk around a take pictures which was really the only reason we wanted a rooftop bar.
It started raining hard and we were under a shelter which I quite liked. It did also mean that even when it did open, it wasn't very busy. I imagined that it got busier later in the evening. 
We were given lots of free Crisps which were a welcome treat and ordered two classic and delicious cocktails. 
We hadn't planned on staying long but our waitress was so lovely (Dao) and we got chatting. We were then told we were getting free "sunset oysters" which we found very hard to believe but shortly afterwards came the most delicious oysters I have ever had! 
Literally out of this world good! They had egg yolk and cavier in and they were just perfect. 

We ordered chips too which we devoured. Our first taste of proper chips in a long time.. they were covered in bacon and cheese and a spice and they were heaven. They even bought ketchup without asking👌

We were speaking to Dao some more and she recommended some more unusual cocktail, I tried Eden which I loved! 

They made us feel so special even though at first I felt very underdressed. 
We loved it so much we are going back.

That actually made me suspicious upon arrival and it never settled throughout the dinner. Either they were busy with themselves or with their phones. In a restaurant that barely served 30 guests that night I do expect a little more than a mid-class service. Especially if the prices for food and beverage are fine dining. The service is surely not a reason to come back this place. 

The cocktails are good and really to recommend. Those we tried were all perfectly exercised and also fairly priced. The wine menu - well, what to say? It is rather a wild selection of something that supposed to look luxurious. There is no way to find a logic in the menu unless you just look for high prices.

We had a couple of dishes some great some rather below. For sure the most simple dish - a chicken liver terrine was fantastic! The same applies to a beef tartar and salmon tartar. Both were top. On the other hand, an uninspired salmon with no seasoning and a white wine sauce was just a taste bud disaster. The rib-eye served was no magic and was even prepared close to bleu instead the ordered medium. And please do not try the black cod - its not worth the money....

So all in all - not sure if we will go there again. There are too many questions unanswered and for the money paid - I dont think its worth especially not with the attention to service culture. 

By the way ambiance, chinaware and view a great. If that creates your main experience - you will be surely in the right place.

sohy or solow? It depends on your reference.
Jun 2017 • Business
Yes this place should have it all. Roof top (they popping up in Ho Chi Minh City like mushrooms). High end designer for the interior in a vibrant City.
They were not lucky to open it in June in the middle of the raining season, since the emphasis is on the outside lounge part, and less on the fine dining part.
It all seems to come together pretty well. Even though the interior of the dining area is very woody, it give you the impression of a Swiss ski chalet, but with a very different view.
The food served is good, the service fine. Once going down to the lounge area things change.

1. The music system is too loud (9 pm), like they are competing with another rooftop bar on the next office building.
2. As one of the reviewers remarked correctly, the dress code is not enforced (yet?), allowing shorts and flip flops.
3. When ordering bottles (either red wines or champagnes), it is striking that the costings are like the name of the lounge 'SOHY'. It is ok to charge a premium for such a beautiful placed rooftop bar, but it is in contrast with point 1 and 2, because you attract a very different audience.

Conclusion: I will think twice to go here again for dinner or an occasional bottle with business partners.

See Saigon like never before!
Jun 2017 • Friends
After seeing a post on facebook about the Grand Opening, my friends and I decided to check out Saigon's newest rooftop bar. From the second we entered from the elevator we were were impressed with the the venue. It oozes class. 

View - The first thing you can't help but notice is the stunning views from the top. I have been to many of the other rooftop bars around Saigon but the 360 degree view here blew us away! Brilliant place to get some photos with the Saigon skyline! A great place to bring a date I would say ;-)

Venue - With three separate floors to explore, you have a choice of different venues. The champagne garden is perfect for a party or to impress visiting friends. We were told that the music and ambience on each floor are altered which is pretty cool! 

Drinks - We took advantage of some of the drink promotions during the opening night so we really felt we got value for our money on this front. My girlfriend tried the signature mojito and said she would return for this alone! We were told they do a really good midweek happy hour that we will return for.

Service - The smiling friendly faces you see once you walk inside was nice to see. The hostess went out of her way to ensure we enjoyed our experience there which we were grateful for. It was pretty busy on the night and have been in Asia long enough to see many places here unable to deal with big crowds. We didn't have this problem here thankfully.

Atmosphere - The night we visited the place was hopping. The DJ on the night was on fire and we enjoyed a dance as the drinks flowed!

Overall - We will definitely be returning on a normal evening to sample the restaurant food and enjoy some delicious cocktails. Thanks for a great evening and keep it up!
